fieldValues.title: Destructive and partial writes succeed silently
fieldValues.statement: Several operations report success while leaving the repository broken or half changed: deleting an in-use definition, an aborted migration leaving partial output, a declared-but-unknown extension loading without comment, a record update that replaces values it was not asked to touch. Agents following one tool's input shape on another get a success result while part of the write is ignored.
source_ref: srs-context:CLI note create silently ignores a containerId in the payload
